purpose: Controlled corpus for the independent critic of the delivered MP4 (W67): clean controls and seeded defects, per format.

adjudication.note: No project adjudicator exists yet (owner decision pending). Ground truth is the unchanged Open Images human box of each photograph. The visual inspection below was made by the Claude writer agent, an automated step; it is NOT a human adjudication.

rules: R1: status eligible, rights original_landing_confirmed, licence CC BY 2.0 or 4.0 (per-photo audit already done in W61 V5)
R2: exactly one annotated box in the image, label Human face, Source xclick or activemil, IsOccluded=IsTruncated=IsGroupOf=IsDepiction=0
R3: mirror width and height even, no EXIF orientation, Rotation 0.0
R4: the framing rules (corpus-geometry.mjs) can frame the face in BOTH formats: good window, lost window, a caption band covering the framed face, a free bottom band
R5: rank ascending by sha256("w67-mp4-v1|select|<ImageID>") and take the first N; no result of any detector, renderer or critic enters the selection
R6: visual exclusion, from the source photograph only: the annotated "face" is a depiction (printed or painted portrait) or other faces are plainly visible and unannotated
selection.rehearsal: the selection rule was bypassed: design rehearsal on the development split, not a registered corpus

independence.holdout: The W62 holdout (V5 sets.holdout, Open Images test split) was never opened, listed or read by this work.
independence.productDetector: The product detector OMZ face-detection-0204 (V9) ran in W62 on the 60 DEVELOPMENT images only (owner-receipt 390d3b28d172015f8ed2cb3d416e38625ce4d4efaca8e1eea52d7a8e58aaa817: 60 ids, all in development, none in calibration or holdout).
independence.calibrationUse: The calibration split was evaluated in W61 by YuNet (V5, V6) and by face-detection-retail-0004 (V7) with preregistered configurations that were never changed afterwards; the operating points used here (score 0.50) are those preregistered ones. No threshold of this protocol was chosen on calibration pixels.
independence.engineering: Policy, geometry and generator were designed and rehearsed on synthetic content and on DEVELOPMENT-split photographs before this freeze; see the preregistration document.

groundTruth.convention: Open Images "Human face" box (visible face), normalized to the image
groundTruth.origin: Open Images validation human-drawn boxes (Source xclick/activemil), preserved verbatim
groundTruth.eyes: unknown: no eye annotation, eye checks are out of scope and not counted

oracle.union: every box of omz-face-detection-0204-v9 and omz-face-detection-retail-0004 (not merged), plus the registered projection of the source detections; unknown when no face evidence exists

controls.renderer: FfmpegEditorialProxyRenderer (the product renderer), proxy canvas of each format

acceptance.exactLocalization: flagged frames of the defect class equal the labelled interval; frames adjacent to it are negatives
acceptance.ifNotMet: the face-related checks FAIL and that is the result: no tuning, no relabelling, no new threshold

limits: Eyes are unknown (no eye annotation): eye detection and eye safety are not evaluated.
Twenty outputs from two photographs are mechanical controls, not a population estimate and not natural video: the source is a held still.
Ground truth completeness (no other face in the photograph) rests on the Open Images validation annotation; it was not adjudicated by a human.

The caption defect uses face evidence handed to the planner (phantom boxes, omitted real face); the defect position is decided here from public preset geometry, the final band is the planner's ordinary result and is reported against the label.
Density has no seeded defect: it is measured on every output (false positives only), its recall is not evaluated.
The proxy canvas (540x960 / 960x540) is the delivered MP4 of these outputs.
